EFS/S17.title: Microphone blocked / no microphone in every Dictate box (vis-efs-s17-mic-blocked.spec.ts)
EFS/S17.stated: TFA-94745 state 8 (microphone blocked: explain how to enable it)
EFS/S17.detail: Oracle cells pass in both runs (NotAllowedError and NotFoundError): every box explains how to allow the microphone and keeps the typed line. Still B27: in the Hospital pre-round editor the yellow 'Dictation done — review before saving' shows together with the red microphone message although nothing was dictated. Recorded: the no-microphone wording still says 'blocked'; the editor's message has no live region.
